pages.name: Benoni: Four Pawns, Taimanov, 9.a4 a6 10.Bd3
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Na6-c7 with a pawn on a6; plan 3 put the bishop on c2 to support d5 (it cannot); plan 1 relied on g4-g5. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Four Pawns, Taimanov, 9.a4 a6 10.Be2
pages.notes: Plan 2 rerouted the d7-knight via f8 to e6. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Four Pawns, Taimanov, 9.a4 O-O
pages.notes: Plan 4 sent the d7-knight to f8, where the rook stands; plan 2 read ...b5 with the bishop on b5. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Four Pawns, Taimanov, 9.a4 O-O 10.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 2 named a rook on e8 that is on f8; plan 3 read ...b5 with the bishop on b5. Rewrote plans 2-3; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Four Pawns, Taimanov, 9.a4 O-O 10.Nf3 Na6
pages.notes: Plan 4 sent the d7-knight via f8 (rook there) to e6; plan 2 pushed ...b7-b5 onto the bishop. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Four Pawns, Taimanov, 9.a4 O-O 10.Nf3 Na6 11.O-O Nc7
pages.notes: Plan 2 pushed ...b5 onto the bishop on b5. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Four Pawns, Taimanov, 9.a4 Qh4+
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Kg2 with the king on e1; plan 2 used the dark-squared g7-bishop on light squares (reviewer catch); plan 3 had an unsourced Rb1 and b4 plan. Rewrote plans 1-3; plan 4 wording.

pages.name: Benoni: Four Pawns, Taimanov, 9.Bd3 O-O 10.Nf3
pages.notes: Plan 2 put a knight on e5, covered by the f4-pawn and the f3-knight; plan 3 used a3 to stop ...b5. Rewrote plans 2-3; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Four Pawns, 9.Be2 Bg4
pages.notes: Overview called ...Bg4 a pin (the e2-bishop stands behind the knight); plan 1 pushed g4-g5 onto the bishop. Rewrote overview phrase and plan 1; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Four Pawns, Main Line, 10.e5: 12.Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed g4-g5 into its own g5-bishop; plan 2 ignored that 12.Bg5 attacks the d8-queen; plan 3 put the queen on f3 or h4 through the e2-bishop. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling.
